title: Split susi-gmcp core tools and gmcp_requirements monoliths and ratchet lean-core ceilings
goal: Separate crates/susi-gmcp/src/tools/core.rs (4,240 lines) by domain into 6 submodules plus src/tests/core_tools.rs, split tests/gmcp_requirements.rs (~36k lines) by VC-203 vector with shared support modules, enforce per-file and ratcheted category/pillar ceilings in tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs, and re-record append-only GMCP evidence.

reuse.searched: crates/susi-gmcp/src/tools/*, crates/susi-gmcp/src/tests/*, tests/gmcp_requirements.rs, tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs, scripts/gmcp-record-evidence.sh, xtask/src/gmcp_evidence.rs
reuse.source: Existing CoreTools module layout, tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs budget harness, and xtask/src/gmcp_evidence.rs split-test reader
reuse.reason: Refactor existing CoreTools and gmcp_requirements.rs monoliths into modular submodules/include files while extending existing ceiling and evidence tooling.
